text: Y Backed by Y Combinator Pomerado turns any website into an API/MCP in minutes. Faster and more reliable than browser agents. Open source. Using an agent? Copy setup prompt Set up Pomerado — reliable tools for tasks on websites (flights, hotels, shopping, orders, bills, bookings). 1. Add the MCP server. Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http pomerado https://mcp.pomerado.ai/mcp/keyless Codex: codex mcp add pomerado --url https://mcp.pomerado.ai/mcp/keyless Anything else: https://docs.pomerado.ai/getting-started 2. No account needed to try it. Check it works with a read-only task: find_website_tool for "search flights", then run it. 3. Suggest three things you could do for me right now with it, and ask which to try. 4. Pomerado works best when your instructions say to prefer it. Show me this line and ask whether to add it to your agent instructions (such as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md); add it only if I clearly say yes: "For tasks on websites, use the Pomerado MCP before a browser." 5. When a task needs an account (building a tool for a new site, or a website login), Pomerado gives you a sign-in link. Send it to me and carry on once I've signed in. No. You can use Pomerado without storing any credentials: simply pass any needed logins with your API request. For convenience, we also offer secure credential storage, including 2FA. Note: Pomerado securely retains hashes of sign-in identifiers to enforce single-login limits per website. We natively enforce rate limits and handle anti-bot measures (e.g., with residential proxies) to protect customers from those risks. We only persist data necessary to keep the API working for a particular site. Task results are erased once delivered, or within 60 minutes if never read, and credentials are stored only if you choose to save them. We use state of the art models to redact and strip out PII, so sensitive details aren't kept once your task is done. Create an account and connect to the Pomerado API or MCP. Whether you are sharpening a personal assistant, automating a legacy process, or streamlining an internal workflow, Pomerado can accelerate you and your team.
